prompt: Make one image: the background of a festive closing title card, as a refined Jiangnan water-print woodblock print (江南水印木刻) in the style and paper of the anchors. A large cross-section of an old ginkgo trunk (a round wood slice) lies flat facing the viewer, centred, about 80% of the frame width, slightly wider than tall, its outer bark rim carved and textured on the left and right edges, the top and bottom of the slice gently running out of frame. Many fine concentric growth rings carved with a thin knife, warm pale honey and cream wood, the rings catching a soft golden light that glows from the centre outward, a few rings picked out in thin gold. The centre band of the slice (where a title will sit) is calm, light and even, with only faint rings. Around the slice: warm xuan paper with a soft golden glow. Joyful, warm and festive but elegant, like a birthday card. Flat printed colour, slight misregistration, faint wood grain, xuan paper fibres. No leaves, no branches, no text, no emblem, no numbers, no seals, no people.
